editorial:
You follow Terry, a small-time car dealer who wants a clean life, when Martine, a model from his old neighborhood, brings him a bank robbery plan that sounds too good to pass up. What starts as a simple heist quickly pulls you into a bigger mess involving corrupt officials, hidden secrets, and dangerous people who want those safe deposit boxes kept quiet. The movie has a gritty London feel, but it never loses its fun, old-school heist energy. You get planning scenes, close calls, and a story that keeps widening just when you think you understand it.

The cast keeps everything grounded, especially Jason Statham, who plays Terry with more heart and worry than his usual tough-guy roles. The pacing stays brisk, the tension builds well, and the twists make the robbery feel bigger than cash. Some side characters and subplots can feel crowded, and a few historical details are simplified, but the ride stays entertaining. If you enjoy smart crime stories with real stakes, this is a strong pick. Watch it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: The crew successfully robs the bank and discovers the safe deposit boxes hold explosive secrets, including photos and documents tied to powerful people. Instead of just running, Terry uses that evidence as leverage, forcing MI5 and corrupt officials to back off and let his team walk away safely. The robbery becomes a public mystery, but the real truth stays buried. Terry returns to his family with the money, leaving the dangerous secrets behind and finally getting the fresh start he wanted.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves clever heist thrillers with real-world stakes.
